title: Corporate AI Upskilling Programme
description: An in-house programme that takes a whole team from AI curiosity to shipping real internal tools.
overview: Delivered at your office or online for a single cohort, this programme is built around your own workflows rather than generic examples. Teams finish with two or three working internal tools and a shared vocabulary for deciding where AI helps and where it does not.
syllabus: How language models actually behave, and where they fail
Prompt design and structured output for repeatable results
Retrieval over your own documents and data
Wiring a model into an existing internal tool
Governance, data handling and cost control
whoShouldJoin: Operations and support teams handling repetitive document work
In-house developers adding AI features to existing systems
Managers deciding where AI is worth the investment
learningOutcomes: Identify which of your workflows are genuinely a fit for AI
Build and deploy an internal assistant grounded in company data
Measure output quality rather than trusting impressions
Set sensible guardrails on cost, access and data handling
prerequisites: Basic computer literacy across the cohort
At least one participant comfortable with Python
projects: An internal document assistant grounded in your own files
An automation that classifies and routes incoming requests
certificate: ASB Training Hub Corporate Programme certificate for every participant, plus a written handover of the tools built during the programme.

faqs.q: Can the programme be delivered at our office?
faqs.a: Yes. Sessions run on-site anywhere in Kerala, online for distributed teams, or as a mix of both.

faqs.q: How large can a cohort be?
faqs.a: We keep cohorts to 20 so every participant gets hands-on time. Larger teams are split across parallel batches.

faqs.q: Do you sign an NDA before working with our data?
faqs.a: Yes. We sign your NDA before any project scoping, and the programme can be run entirely on anonymised or synthetic data if you prefer.
Pricing depends on cohort size, duration and whether delivery is on-site. Contact us on +91 87147 73304 for a quote.

content:
Corporate AI upskilling at ASB Training Hub is built around your team's actual work, not generic examples. We start by mapping the workflows that consume the most time, then build tooling for two or three of them during the programme itself.

How it runs

Sessions are delivered on-site at your office, online, or as a mix. A cohort is capped at 20 people so everyone gets hands-on time with a trainer. The programme runs four to eight weeks depending on how deep you want to go.

What your team leaves with

Working internal tools, not slideware. Every cohort finishes with deployed automations built on the company's own data, plus documentation so the work survives after the programme ends.

Arranging a programme

Call +91 87147 73304 or email info@asbtraininghub.com to discuss cohort size, scheduling and scope. We are happy to run a short discovery session first at no cost.

title: Weekend Agentic AI Workshop
description: A two-day hands-on workshop where you build and deploy a working AI agent from scratch.
overview: Two full days, one agent, deployed by the end. This workshop suits people who have read about agents but never built one, and want a guided first build rather than a lecture series.
syllabus: What separates an agent from a single prompt
Giving an agent memory and context
Deploying the agent so it has a live URL
whoShouldJoin: Developers who want a guided first agent build
Anyone who has read about agents but not built one
learningOutcomes: Build an agent that plans and calls tools
Explain when an agent is the wrong choice
Deploy your build and share a live link
Debug an agent that loops or stalls
projects: A research agent that gathers sources and writes a summary
certificate: ASB Training Hub Workshop certificate, issued on completion of the deployed build.

faqs.q: Do I need prior AI experience?
faqs.a: No, but you do need to be comfortable writing basic Python. The AI concepts are taught from scratch.

faqs.q: What do I need to bring?
faqs.a: A laptop with Python installed. We provide API access for the weekend, so there is nothing to buy.

faqs.q: Will I finish with something working?
faqs.a: Yes. Everyone deploys their agent by the end of day two and leaves with a live URL and the source code.

content:
This is a build workshop, not a lecture series. Over two days you go from an empty file to a deployed AI agent that plans, calls tools and returns a useful result.

Day one

What an agent actually is, how tool calling works, and getting a first loop running locally. By the end of the day your agent completes a simple multi-step task.

Day two

Memory and context, handling failure and runaway loops, then deployment. You finish with a live URL you can share and the source code to keep building on.

Booking

Workshops run monthly with limited seats. Call +91 87147 73304 to check the next date.

title: ERP FICO Certification Track
description: A focused track that prepares working professionals for ERP FICO certification alongside a full-time job.
overview: Evening and weekend sessions aimed squarely at the certification syllabus, with configuration practice in a sandbox system and mock exams throughout. Designed for people already working who need a structured path rather than open-ended study.
syllabus: Financial accounting: general ledger, accounts payable and receivable
Controlling: cost centres, profit centres and internal orders
Integration with materials management and sales
Certification exam patterns and mock papers
learningOutcomes: Configure a full financial accounting module end to end
Run a complete month-end close in a sandbox system
Answer certification-style questions under time pressure
Explain FICO integration points in an interview
prerequisites: Availability for evening or weekend sessions
projects: A full FICO configuration in a sandbox
certificate: ASB Training Hub completion certificate plus structured preparation for the official ERP certification exam, which is booked and sat separately.

faqs.q: Does this include the official ERP exam fee?
faqs.a: No. The track prepares you for the exam; the exam itself is booked and paid for directly with ERP. We help with scheduling.

faqs.q: Can I do this while working full time?
faqs.a: Yes, that is exactly who it is designed for. Sessions run in the evenings and at weekends.
Yes, every participant gets their own sandbox login for the duration of the track and four weeks afterwards.

content:
This track is built for people already in work who need a structured route to ERP FICO certification rather than open-ended self-study.

How it is scheduled

Sessions run in the evenings and at weekends across twelve weeks. Every participant gets their own sandbox login, kept active for four weeks after the track ends so you can keep practising.

Exam preparation

Mock papers run throughout, not just at the end, so weak areas surface early. The official ERP exam is booked and paid for separately; we help with scheduling and readiness.

Enrolling

Call +91 87147 73304 or email info@asbtraininghub.com for the next batch date and fee structure.
